scenario_title: Case B — Elevated Risk, Limited Evidence
decision_explanation: 14-day risk score is 0.74 (elevated) but only 43 days of maintenance history are available and key maintenance fields have low availability. Do not auto-escalate based on risk score alone. A manual inspection is required to verify the prediction before scheduling proactive maintenance.
